hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Processing an item earlier scales its multiplier across remaining steps.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Sort cost contributions in ascending order so larger costs incur fewer multipliers.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Accumulate the ordered cost products to achieve the minimal total.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minTotalCostToProcess(costs: list[int]) -> int:
    costs.sort(reverse=True)
    total = 0
    for idx, c in enumerate(costs):
        total += (idx + 1) * c
    return total
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all processing permutations scales as factorial complexity.
